title: R6-01: P0 runtime + hotel: IHG reaches select-enhance-stay but ends 'verification unavailable' -> verified READY; honest 'checkpoint reached, to verify' state (P13); live-frame gap heartbeat; Vueling chromewebdata diagnosis; R6 docs/queue/owner feedback
spec:
Reproduce round-5 IHG select-enhance-stay failures offline with synthetic
observations and identify verification gates. Internal verify_failed logs contain
gate names only, never values/PII or UI diagnostics. Demand exact hotel
verification keys per _VERIFY_FIELDS, selected=true, next_safe_boundary and ISO
dates. Explain/validate zero-based IHG qCiMy/qCoMy (062027 = July 2027).
Normalize only safe tracking noise in handoff equality; genuine checkpoint
frame, correct city/dates/party and no beyond_pattern remain mandatory.

P13 adds blocked/checkpoint_unverified with optional checkpoint_reached=true,
reviewed public framed-checkpoint handoff under P10, friendly FR/EN reached-to-
verify copy, never READY/provider_error for failed verification. Preserve both
fields throughout provider/API/synthetic serialization. Preserve supplied valid
frame observed_at; omit future/malformed timestamps.

Polling-driven frame-gap heartbeat after >20 s, at most every 20 s, friendly
monotonic observed step labels only, zero fabricated frames. Record measured
H metric-duration intervals internally. First nonblank chromewebdata/chrome-error/
about:neterror ends promptly blocked/provider_error, internal
site_unreachable_in_h only. Diagnose Vueling live including plain homepage;
do not change provider ordering in this ticket.

Own core app/models/providers/hclient/scrub integration, hotel, CONTRACTS P1–P13,
R6 queue/ticket definitions, owner feedback, shared docs and scope migration.
Quota-gated sequential real hotel smokes through build_task+hclient for Milan,
Lisbon, Amsterdam or Zurich using current sourced official race dates; target
>=2 READY at select-enhance-stay. Inspect failures without weakening checks.
Coordinate final visible integrated acceptance after sibling tickets merge,
rebasing and recording within allowed evidence/handoff paths only.
acceptance:
- Python 3.12: uv sync --frozen; uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest -q.
- Offline complete IHG shape -> READY with checkpoint handoff; missing/incorrect/
  empty verification -> blocked/checkpoint_unverified, checkpoint_reached=true,
  reviewed public handoff, never provider_error. July 062027 valid; real wrong
  month -> date_mismatch. No frame/beyond pattern never READY. Gate names only.
- Fake clock: >=2 friendly monotonic heartbeats after a 60s observation gap,
  spaced >=20s, zero fabricated frames. Initial browser error -> provider_error
  within 20s; internal site_unreachable_in_h and duration intervals.
- HTTP API normal/future/malformed observed_at plus both P13 fields preserved.
- Exact R6 queue/allowed files, disjointness, valid paths/dependencies/doc lists,
  P13/checkpoint_unverified contract markers; remove old R5 scope test.
- Dated scrubbed hotel/h-client evidence: race/stay, status/reason/checkpoint/
  gates, steps/time, public host/path only, quota/cleanup; >=2 real IHG READY,
  Vueling deep-link/plain-homepage finding and measured interval distribution.
  Remaining mismatches unresolved unless actually diagnosed. Backend-only hotel
  smokes are not integrated visible three-agent acceptance.
